# Hybrid scheduling program

Approved: selective final-XOR algebra, cache/engine rebalancing, multi-decision learned/random proposals, targeted exact repair, and verification. Primary metric is lowest complete frozen-verified cycles, with scratch<=1536 before lowering or execution. Keep production5691617, tests, simulator, previous reports and the original untimed solver1059154 unchanged. No installs, commits, pushes, cloud jobs or submissions.

Control981/1465, global-rewrite985/1465. Mixed final representation is allowed only after the final hash and before each block's store. Prove the local identity, reproduce empty/all masks, and independently check mixed-block output ownership. Runtime input values never enter proposal generation or learning.

A. Selective algebra: two controls, all32 single-block masks, all28 pairs among the eight latest-storing native blocks, and cumulative late-block masks of sizes2..9. Deduplicate configurations. At most70 evaluations; retain late-order metadata and actual stores. Native compiler preferences otherwise unchanged.

B. Joint rebalancing: choose two best nonempty masks. Evaluate eight ALU/VALU preferences for the final shift, early constant XOR and final combine for each mask. Around the best two distinct mask/preference settings, evaluate all64 one-cache toggles. Around the best two resulting settings evaluate four adjacent selector profiles. Recheck eight final-engine profiles around the best two settings. At most168 evaluations, global deduplication. Keep slower standalone choices eligible for the specified joint tests; do not infer additive savings.

C. Multi-decision proposals: use the best feasible A/B graph. Collect64 native frontier snapshots after startup. Each proposal requests2..4 first-choice overrides at distinct snapshot cycles, with at least one cycle<=615. Generate192 training plans,48 held-out plans and a384-plan unmeasured pool, all disjoint and deterministically seeded. Plans see only native compiler-state features; later requested decisions may encounter a changed frontier. Skip unavailable ordinals and record applied/skipped decisions. Targets are actual completed cycles, not predicted utilization. Infeasible plans have no executed cycle label.

GPU ranking: train linear, MLP and two-layer width128/four-head transformer plan scorers,600 updates each, batch64, on the192 training plans only. Plan tokens describe proposed edits and their native context; no instruction-ID embeddings. Use final fixed checkpoints; held-out plans are evaluation only. Each model selects16 pool plans, and a seeded random control selects16. Compile shared selections once but report attribution to every selecting method. At most304 measured plans across training, held-out and pool selection. Compare against the retained native and best training/held-out proposal. This is supervised plan ranking, not full reinforcement learning. No automatic second training round.

D. Exact repair: independently capture the best nonempty A/B rewrite graph, with target min(980,seed_cycles-1). Use fresh RAW dependencies, native fixed engine modes and global SSA reallocation. Preflight suffix widths32/64/128/256/512 with +/-8 displacement, no load pins; run only the first scope passing difference and capacity checks. At most one new untimed optimization solve,2GiB address-space cap. Do not start an identical prior query. Recheck native model/reconstruction and corruption controls before solving. No current or new solver gets a wall/CPU deadline. No automatic memory increase or additional case after unknown/OOM. Exact work runs beside C rather than blocking GPU training. A SAT timing witness is not executable until SSA allocation fits and independent checks pass.

Execution: persistent local supervisor, max3 CPU rollout workers plus existing solver and at most one new exact worker. GPU training uses existing ROCm environment, devicegfx1100, approximate4GiB allocator cap, CPU library threads1. Finite evaluation/update counts, no time deadlines. Stop a phase on correctness, schema, corruption-control or provenance failure. Reject excessive scratch without lowering. Resource failures remain unknown, not UNSAT. Do not rerun completed evaluations silently.

Verification: native controls, algebra proof, source hashes, masks, instruction coverage, independent lane ownership and corruption sensitivity. Any new overall winner needs100 full-width seeds, five patterns, deterministic rebuilds, frozen/supplementary/source-only and prior-ceiling gates before strong verification. Do not integrate saved masks, plans or schedules into production. Report source of every gain, measured failures, unfinished exact work and remaining promotion gates.
C_addendum:
# C allocation after the A/B result, before any C evaluation

A/B retained the original 981/1465 baseline. Its best nonempty selective rewrite also reached981, at1473 words. To test the requested combination rather than train only on the unchanged graph, split the already declared C budget evenly between these two graphs.

Each graph supplies64 native state snapshots,96 training plans,24 held-out plans and192 unmeasured pool plans. Totals remain192 training,48 held-out,384 pool, and at most64 measured pool selections. Each model and the random control select eight pool plans per graph,16 per method. Train joint models on both graphs with structural resource summaries, not graph-ID embeddings. The held-out split is by plans, not unseen graph families.

No evaluation or training budget increases. The exact worker uses the selective graph independently. Record native-state features as proposal proxies: earlier edits can change the frontier encountered by later edits. Unavailable requests become recorded no-ops, not illegal issues.

verification.remaining: automatic production selection, cold build and integration review; exact worker is independent
